about_the_game:
This is the demo version of CoreRunner.

About the demo:

This demo contains 9 stages of one level, specially designed to give you a glimpse of the final game. You have some of the essential game mechanics, and get an introduction to the general gameplay and style of the environment.

About the game:

SKATE. SLASH. SHOOT. SURVIVE.

CoreRunner is a high-speed 3rd person runner/shooter that fuses sword and gun combat with luminous light trails to create an entirely unique playstyle. Set in the neon-drenched future of the Core — a network of spherical worlds designed as digital prisons — you'll fight your way to freedom across stunning synthwave landscapes.

FEATURES

  • Revolutionary Combat System: Leave snake-like light trails as you skate through arenas, wielding dual swords and dual pistols, with 360° attack coverage.

  • Aural Experience: Every environment and gameplay sequence crafted around pulsing synthwave tracks.

  • Stunning Visual Design: Retrowave aesthetics with vibrant neon lighting and stylized effects that turn combat into visual art.

  • Adaptive Difficulty: Face increasingly hostile patrols and environmental hazards as you progress deeper through the Core.

  • Precision Controls: Master the bespoke controller system designed for lightning-fast reactions and fluid movement.

Carve your path through waves of digital guardians while the environment itself turns against you. Every level pulses with electric intensity, every firefight becomes a test of agility and timing. The Core wants to keep you. Only a CoreRunner can lead the way out.

content_descriptors.notes: Characters show reactions when taking damage and emit light particle effects.
